verdict.reason: The hypothesis says committed offsets (records) were deleted by retention, which points to order-sync and Kafka retention. It does not tell the reset-to-latest story as the cause; it only declines to rule it out. It is a thin hypothesis, but it covers retention and deletion, and it implies the first failure is the consumer and the root cause is Kafka retention.
